name: Dedicated Point Defense Gunners
desc:
While not as effective as IPDAI, it still allows all point-defense weapons the ability to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. Also increases all damage to missiles by %s.

However, it doesn't give them the best target leading and increases minimum crew required by %s.
short: PD ignores decoy flares, more damage to missiles, increase crew requirement.
sModDesc:
All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as "point-defense", automatically target missiles, and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers. 

Improved gunner seats gives them the improved target leading and only increases minimum crew required by %s.

name: Insulated Hull
desc: Decreases the amount of EMP damage taken from weapons such as Ion Cannons by %s and increases the ship's hull integrity by %s.
short: Increases hull integrity; decrease EMP damage taken.
sModDesc: Further decreases the amount of EMP damage taken from weapons such as Ion Cannons by %s and further increases the ship's hull integrity by %s.

name: Naval Hull
desc: Allows you to equip naval packages onto a ship.
short: Allows for installation of naval packages.

name: Naval Package: Armor Removal
desc: Some drunkard suggested at a bar one day, What if no armor, best armor? And from that day I could only do what science must be done.
short: Increases maneuverability and other factors, while compromising hull and armor.

name: Naval Package: Armor Reinforcement
desc: The ship's armor belts have been thickened at key areas, along with numerous hull integrity improvements. In the process some crew and storage compartments were rearranged or outright removed to make space for armor. Alongside this package is also the noticable lack of manueverablity upgrades, so be ready to sail a brick depending on ship size.
short: Increased armor and hull, less maneuverability.

name: Naval Package: Mobility Package
desc: The engine room has been expanded, and additional maneuvering thrusters were installed. This allows for greater mobility at the cost of hull integrity and reduced armor to make room for the improvements.
short: Increased maneuverability, less hull hp and armor.

name: Naval Package: Active Radar Station
desc: Additional Lidar and Radar equipment has been installed on the masts of the ship along with other smaller sensors. This increases sensor range by %s, but will also increases sensor profile by %s (Frigate/Destroyer/Cruiser/Capital). There is no real downsides besides the need to increase minimum crew to seat the new stations.
short: Increased sensor range and increased sensor profile.

name: Naval Package: Dedicated Shield Generator
desc: Experimental technology this is, atleast to us. Some compromises have been made to fit this device, but the shield should theortically be decently strong despite the downsides.
short: Adds a shield at the cost of certain compromises.

name: Naval Package: Semi-Armor Piercing Shells
short: Increases damage of weapons against Hull.

name: Naval Package: Anti-Shield Capped High Explosive Shells
desc: Improves damage against shields and hull.
short: Increases damage of weapons againt Shields.
